prompts.object: Editorial still life photograph of a hand-built tabletop model made of paper, card, matte ceramic and brushed steel, photographed as a physical object on a plain pale surface, soft north-window light with long gentle shadows, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, matte film grade with lifted whites. Oblique view of a hand-built model of terraced hillside bands in blue paper, each terrace tiled with small six-sided hexagon fields, every terrace edge a clean flat line and the top a smooth rounded crest. Subject centred with a generous quiet margin around it, every key element near the middle of the frame. Color palette: crisp white and pale mist-blue surfaces, deep blue and slate, soft grey. There is exactly one amber object in the frame: one hexagon field on the middle terrace in amber glass. All other objects are white, grey, blue or slate. No text, no logos, no writing.
